en_title: Dave Bautista in Talks to Join God of War TV Series as Kratos
cn_title: Dave Bautista或将饰演《战神》奎托斯
subtitle: 战神换人？
opus_summary: Dave Bautista据称正在洽谈出演Prime Video真人剧《战神》中的奎托斯，此前饰演该角色的Ryan Hurst因肱二头肌受伤退出。若谈判顺利，剧集计划在秋季恢复制作，第二季还可能更换Atreus演员。

paragraphs.en: Dave Bautista is reportedly in talks to become Kratos in Prime Video's live-action God of War TV series.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Dave Bautista正在洽谈出演Prime Video真人剧《战神》中的奎托斯。

paragraphs.en: According to Variety and Deadline , Bautista has entered discussions to become PlayStation's beloved, brooding protagonist. The news comes just a few weeks after actor Ryan Hurst was dropped from the series after a bicep injury, which will require surgery. The production opted to recast Kratos as Hurst's injury means he won't be able to return to the series until sometime next year. If Bautista signs on, the plan is to get the show up and rolling again by the fall.
paragraphs.cn: 据《综艺》和Deadline报道，Bautista已开始洽谈出演PlayStation备受喜爱、性格阴郁的主角。就在几周前，演员Ryan Hurst因肱二头肌受伤退出剧集，而伤势需要接受手术。由于Hurst要到明年某个时候才能回归剧集，制作方决定重新选角饰演奎托斯。如果Bautista签约，剧集计划在秋季重新启动制作。

paragraphs.en: One advantage of Bautista provided by sources is that the actor is naturally already bulked up and wouldn't need months of training in order to get into the physique fans expect from Kratos. The actor is best known for his physical stature, having played Drax in the Guardians of the Galaxy films and hulking foes in films like Blade Runner 2049. He also has a history as a professional wrestler in the WWE, so he has the physical chops for it. The actor has also been looking to stretch his acting muscles, and a character like Kratos may allow him the opportunity to do so.
paragraphs.cn: 消息人士提到，Bautista的一项优势在于他天生已经练就壮硕体格，不需要数月训练就能达到粉丝期待的奎托斯身材。他最为人熟知的就是魁梧身形，曾在《银河护卫队》电影中饰演Drax，也在《银翼杀手2049》等电影中饰演高大强悍的敌人。他还曾是WWE职业摔跤手，因此具备出演这一角色所需的身体条件。此外，这名演员一直希望拓展演技，而奎托斯这样的角色或许能给他这个机会。

paragraphs.en: The actor previously campaigned to star in another adaptation of a franchise that has the GoW acronym: Gears of War. In 2018, he noted that Marcus Fenix was a "dream role" and that he'd actively been pursuing it with the rights holders. He later revealed that Universal, which was once developing Gears of War, wanted him to join the Fast and Furious franchise, but he turned it down in favor of pitching Gears of War . Now, Netflix is developing a Gears of War film, but it seems like PlayStation and Amazon may have beaten them to the punch.
paragraphs.cn: 这名演员此前还曾积极争取出演另一部拥有GoW缩写的系列改编作品：《战争机器》。2018年，他表示Marcus Fenix是自己的「梦想角色」，并一直在主动与版权方争取。后来他透露，曾经开发《战争机器》的环球影业希望他加入《速度与激情》系列，但他拒绝了这一邀请，转而提议制作《战争机器》。如今，Netflix正在开发《战争机器》电影，但看起来PlayStation和亚马逊可能已经抢先一步。

paragraphs.en: Thanks to a report from MP1st , rumors also swirled over the weekend that the God of War TV series may be looking to recast Atreus actor Callum Vinson starting in season 2. It's believed this will allow the series to shoot quickly without having to wait for Vinson to grow up, as there is a three-year time jump between God of War 2018 and God of War Ragnarok, which will likely be the basis for season 2.
paragraphs.cn: 根据MP1st的报道，周末还有传言称，《战神》剧集可能会从第二季开始重新选角，由新的演员饰演Atreus。据信，这样一来剧集就能迅速开拍，不必等待Vinson长大，因为《战神2018》和《战神诸神黄昏》之间存在三年的时间跳跃，而后者很可能成为第二季的基础。

paragraphs.en: To top it all off, multiple new God of War games are also in the works. God of War Laufey is slated to release this coming February , while a new Kratos-led God of War game is also in development .
paragraphs.cn: 除此之外，多款新的《战神》游戏也在开发中。《战神：劳菲》计划于明年2月发售，另一款由奎托斯主导的《战神》游戏也在开发。
